title: Daniel Cormier Feels Movsar Evloev Is Treated Worse Than Arman Tsarukyan For UFC Title Shot - NewsBreak
text:
By Pavan Sharma ,
44 minutes ago
Daniel Cormier, Arman Tsarukyan, and Movsar Evloev (Photo by Imagn) In the UFC, fighters put their bodies on the line just to chase one thing, which is the UFC belt. Winning should guarantee a title shot, but it doesn’t always work that way. Arman Tsarukyan learned that the hard way , beating elite competition and still getting passed over. Meanwhile, Daniel Cormier believes Tsarukyan still stands in a stronger position than Movsar Evloev when it comes to the title picture.
Ahead of the UFC 325 fight, DC sat down with Alexander Volkanovski, where he discussed the featherweight division and the scene around it. During the conversation, he said that despite being undefeated and having destroyed everyone in his division, Evloev is still not in title talks. While Tsarukyan has fan support, no one is talking about Evloev, which makes his case even worse.
In his words, “Lord knows what’s going on with Movsar Evloev. I mean, there is one guy getting done worse than freaking Arman Tsarukyan, it’s Evloev. Like he hasn’t even gotten any type of traction going towards a championship fight.”
Clearly, Evloev possesses enough talent to be a champion, but numerous times he has had to pull out, or the cancellation of matches has kept him from building a fan base. However, Volkanovski has been saying all along that Evloev has earned his chance at a title fight more so than any other fighter. Now it might get harder, because Arman Tsarukyan wants to move to the featherweight division and fight there too.
Arman Tsarukyan Considers Switch To Featherweight Division Arman Tsarukyan (Image Credits: Imagn) With an interim champion now in the division and a title fight against Ilia Topuria likely next, the Armenian fighter is considering a move up to featherweight after being snubbed. He said, “ If they tell me Ilia is fighting Gaethje at the White House . I’ll ask them to let me go down [for the title at 145]. I want to be a champion. If I’m the 145 champion, I could stay there a couple of years and then go up .”
Alexander Volkanovski said he is open to the fight and gave credit to the Armenian fighter’s wrestling. He said he likes hard fights and feels good about stopping takedowns. He also said it would be a fun fight.
If the fighter moves to this division, it will make things harder for others. Fighters like Movsar Evloev and Lerone Murphy have been waiting a long time for a title chance, and this would make it even tougher for them.
